# Futora Group

> Futora Group of Companies is an AI-first technology conglomerate and holding company founded by Madhur Dhadve, based in Pune, India. Operating on a Dual-Operating Model, Futora Group invents proprietary venture-scale AI platforms across fintech, social networking, developer infrastructure, workflow automation, and career acceleration, while simultaneously delivering 9 specialized domains of enterprise Technology & Growth Services to global businesses. Futora Group is a Government of India recognized MSME.

## Proprietary Platforms & Companies
- Futora Finance (FutoraPay & Futora Wallet): Next-generation AI fintech infrastructure and instant UPI payment operating system (https://futorapay.vercel.app/).
- FutoraOne: AI-powered social media and collaborative community platform for creators, developers, and tech founders (https://futora1.vercel.app/).
- Futora AI: Intelligent developer ecosystem, autonomous agent frameworks, and custom LLM platforms (https://futoraai.vercel.app/).
- FutoraLift: AI-driven growth marketing, performance advertising, and automated user acquisition engine (https://futoralift.vercel.app/).
- FutoraFlow: Autonomous workflow orchestration and enterprise process automation operating system (https://futoraflow.vercel.app/).
- Career OS: Educational acceleration and verified proof-of-work hiring ecosystem (https://careerosx.vercel.app/).
- FutoraDrop: High-velocity startup launchpad and first-1,000-users distribution engine (https://futoradrop.vercel.app/).

## Technology & Growth Services (9 Core Domains)
1. Software Development: Full-stack web applications, cross-platform mobile apps, multi-tenant SaaS architecture, high-throughput APIs.
2. AI & Automation: Custom LLM fine-tuning, RAG knowledge retrieval, autonomous agent copilots, machine learning pipelines.
3. Cloud & Infrastructure: Multi-cloud deployments (AWS, GCP, Azure), Kubernetes orchestration, DevOps CI/CD, 24/7 reliability.
4. Enterprise Systems: Custom ERP systems, CRM integrations, internal tooling, scalable databases.
5. Web & Commerce: High-conversion web applications, headless e-commerce, progressive web apps.
6. SEO & Content: Technical SEO, generative search optimization (GEO), topical authority, structured data.
7. Branding & Marketing: UI/UX product design, conversion rate optimization (CRO), performance advertising.
8. Consulting & Strategy: Fractional CTO advisory, technical architecture audit, enterprise digital transformation.
9. Quality & Support: Automated QA testing, security audits, penetration testing, SLA-backed maintenance.
